observations: Photo 0: Black Sony PS4 console (original 'fat' shape, glossy top panel) resting on a stool, with a camouflage-pattern DualShock 4 controller leaning against it.
Photo 1: Same black Sony PS4 console, closer angle, 'SONY' and partial 'PS4' markings visible on the unit, but here a plain black DualShock 4 controller is shown instead of the camo one.
No photo of the rear port panel, power-on/home screen, game library, boxed games, or the UK receipt.
A watermark reading 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' appears on photo 1, suggesting the image may be a dealer/stock photo rather than a photo taken fresh by this private seller.
The two photos show two different-colored controllers even though the seller states '1 pad' is included.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, UK plug, or receipt photo shown
Photo 0 shows a camo controller, photo 1 shows a different plain black controller

claims.claim: 10 pre-installed games including FIFA 27, PES 27, GTA
claims.evidence: No screenshot of the console's game library or home screen; also FIFA 27/PES 27 are not titles that exist, which raises doubt about the accuracy of this claim

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of internal seals, screws, or warranty sticker
No power-on video or close-up of the rear port panel
Text says '1 pad' but also 'original pads' (plural); photos show two different pads across the two images, not one consistent pad
No photo of a receipt provided

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (HDD, disc drive, heat issues)
risks.proof: A power-on video showing boot to the PS4 home screen

risks.risk: Unclear which controller(s) are actually included, and their condition (stick drift, button wear)
risks.proof: A single photo showing all included accessories together, with close-ups of analog sticks
risks.if_unproven: priced as one generic, unverified-condition pad

risks.risk: Pre-installed games claim cannot be confirmed; cited titles (FIFA 27, PES 27) are not real releases, suggesting possible exaggeration
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 library/menu showing installed game titles
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no games

risks.risk: Exact model revision (storage size, CUH number) unknown, which affects value
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear/bottom label showing the CUH model number and storage capacity

risks.risk: UK receipt / provenance claim unverified, affecting trust in 'UK used' claim
risks.proof: A clear photo of the receipt with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as no receipt, origin unverified

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the console booting to the home screen
Photo of all included accessories (console, cable(s), and every controller) laid out together
Screenshot of the installed games library
Photo of the rear label showing CUH model number and storage size
Photo of the UK receipt with legible serial number matching the console
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PlayStation 4 console from the photos, so it can be priced at a worst-case condition (single unverified controller, no proof of working ports or installed games, no confirmed receipt) even though several seller claims remain unverified or are contradicted by the photos.
